description: This file defines an abstract interface class `RRefInterface` related to remote reference handling in PyTorch's distributed and JIT execution context. It declares APIs for accessing owner information, confirmation status, and type information of remote references.

classes.name: RRefInterface
classes.description: An abstract class providing user-facing APIs for remote reference management, including owner worker info, confirmation status, and type.

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns the worker ID of the reference owner.

methods.name: ownerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reference owner.

methods.name: isOwner
methods.description: Checks if this reference is the owner.

methods.name: confirmedByOwner
methods.description: Checks if the reference has been confirmed by its owner.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type information of the remote reference.
